# Configuration reference

Every option can be changed in **Settings** (tray menu). They are stored in `settings.json`, whose
location `eye-tracker doctor` prints. Unknown keys are ignored, missing keys use the defaults below,
and out-of-range values are clamped, so a hand-edited file can never stop the app from starting.

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_config_docs.py from eye_tracker.config; do not edit by hand. -->


## General

| Key | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `general.backend` | `auto` | `auto` · `facemesh` · `lite` | Vision backend. 'facemesh' tracks 478 face landmarks including the irises (head pose + eye direction); 'lite' uses 5 landmarks (head pose only, lowest CPU). 'auto' picks facemesh. |
| `general.start_paused` | `false` |  | Start with tracking paused. |
| `general.first_run_done` | `false` |  | Set after the first-run wizard completes. |
| `general.notifications` | `true` |  | Show tray notifications. |
| `general.log_level` | `INFO` | `DEBUG` · `INFO` · `WARNING` · `ERROR` | Log file verbosity. DEBUG helps with bug reports; logs never contain images or keys. |

## Camera

| Key | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `camera.device` | `0` |  | Camera index ('0', '1', …) or a local video/image file path (useful for testing). On Linux also /dev/videoN or a stable link such as /dev/v4l/by-id/…, which keeps finding a camera that was re-plugged under another number. URLs and other network sources are refused: Eye Tracker works fully offline. |
| `camera.width` | `640` | 160 – 1920 | Requested capture width. |
| `camera.height` | `480` | 120 – 1080 | Requested capture height. |
| `camera.api` | `auto` | `auto` · `dshow` · `msmf` · `avfoundation` · `v4l2` · `any` | OpenCV capture API. |

## Performance

| Key | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `performance.profile` | `balanced` | `eco` · `balanced` · `responsive` | Frame-rate profile. Eco minimises CPU, responsive minimises latency. |
| `performance.motion_gate` | `true` |  | Skip face analysis when the camera image has not changed. |
| `performance.motion_threshold` | `2.0` | 0.1 – 20 | Mean grey-level change that counts as motion. |

## Switching

| Key | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `switching.enabled` | `true` |  | Move the cursor to the monitor you look at. |
| `switching.dwell_ms` | `300` | 0 – 3000 | How long you must look at another monitor before switching. |
| `switching.hysteresis` | `0.06` | 0 – 0.5 | How far (fraction of the monitor size) the gaze must cross into another monitor. |
| `switching.off_screen_margin` | `0.35` | 0.05 – 2 | Gaze further than this (fraction of the monitor diagonal) outside every monitor is treated as looking away (phone, desk) and ignored. |
| `switching.cooldown_ms` | `600` | 0 – 5000 | Minimum time between two switches. |
| `switching.mouse_grace_ms` | `1500` | 0 – 10000 | No switching for this long after you move the mouse. |
| `switching.typing_grace_ms` | `2000` | 0 – 10000 | No switching for this long after you type. |
| `switching.reading_grace_ms` | `6000` | 0 – 60000 | After you typed while looking at another monitor (e.g. copying from a document there), switching to that monitor waits this long after your last keystroke instead of the typing grace, so reading pauses do not move your keyboard focus. 0 turns this off. |
| `switching.cursor_target` | `last` | `last` · `center` · `gaze` | Where the cursor lands: last position on that monitor, its centre, or the estimated gaze point. |
| `switching.focus_window` | `true` |  | Also give keyboard focus to the last-used window on the target monitor. |
| `switching.smoothing` | `0.5` | 0 – 1 | Gaze smoothing strength (0 = raw, 1 = heavy). |

## Walk-away (presence)

| Key | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `presence.enabled` | `true` |  | React when you walk away from the computer. |
| `presence.action` | `lock` | `none` · `notify` · `display_off` · `lock` · `lock_and_display_off` | What to do when you are away. |
| `presence.away_timeout_s` | `45` | 5 – 3600 | Seconds without a face (and without input) before acting. |
| `presence.warning_s` | `10` | 0 – 120 | Countdown shown before the action; any input cancels it. |
| `presence.require_input_idle` | `true` |  | Keyboard or mouse activity counts as presence even without a face. |
| `presence.wake_on_return` | `true` |  | Turn the displays back on when you return (if they were only switched off). |

## Privacy

| Key | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `privacy.pause_when_locked` | `true` |  | Release the camera while the session is locked. |
| `privacy.yield_camera` | `true` |  | Release the camera while another app is using it (Windows and Linux only). |
| `privacy.pause_for_apps` | `[]` |  | Process names that pause tracking while running (e.g. 'obs64.exe'). |
| `privacy.shoulder_guard` | `false` |  | React when a second face appears behind you. |
| `privacy.guard_action` | `curtain` | `notify` · `curtain` · `lock` | Shoulder guard reaction. |
| `privacy.guard_delay_s` | `2.0` | 0.5 – 30 | Seconds a second face must be visible before reacting. |

## Hotkeys

| Key | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hotkeys.enabled` | `true` |  | Register global hotkeys. |
| `hotkeys.toggle_tracking` | `ctrl+alt+meta+t` Windows<br>`ctrl+alt+t` macOS<br>`ctrl+alt+shift+t` Linux |  | Pause / resume tracking. |
| `hotkeys.toggle_privacy` | `ctrl+alt+meta+p` Windows<br>`ctrl+alt+p` macOS<br>`ctrl+alt+shift+p` Linux |  | Privacy mode (camera fully off). |
| `hotkeys.recalibrate` | `ctrl+alt+meta+c` Windows<br>`ctrl+alt+c` macOS<br>`ctrl+alt+shift+c` Linux |  | Start calibration. |

## Learning

| Key | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `learning.adaptive` | `true` |  | Refine the calibration from your natural mouse use. |
| `learning.max_samples` | `400` | 0 – 5000 | Maximum number of learned samples kept. |
| `learning.drift_alerts` | `true` |  | Suggest recalibration when accuracy drops. |

## Interface

| Key | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ui.show_gaze_overlay` | `false` |  | Draw a dot where you are looking (testing aid). |
